comment: Dedicated aziridine N-methyltransferase of mitomycin biosynthesis, SAM-dependent. Methylates the aziridine N-H of C9a-hydroxy and C9a-methoxy aziridinomitosanes. Experiments used S. caespitosus ATCC 27422. mitomycin cluster BGC0000915 (AF127374.2) exists but is retired in MIBiG 4.0

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 fixed reaction SMARTS (was too ambiguous), added description of MIBiG cross-ref.

reactions.description: N-methylation of the aziridine nitrogen of aziridinomitosanes
C9a-hydroxy substrate 3 to 4; the product is then C9a-O-methylated by MitM
C9a-methoxy substrate, mitomycin A (1) to mitomycin F (5)
